grammar.pattern: 啊 / 吧 / 的：语气与话语作用
grammar.purpose: Read stance without inventing a new fact
grammar.explanation: 原来是你啊 conveys recognition; 开始吧 is a suggestion. 好的 acknowledges a request, while 我会来的 expresses assurance. These endings affect how a known proposition is presented; 好的 by itself may leave the time or task unclear, so confirm details. 啊 may sound different after different syllables in natural speech; cite a neutral a and listen to the connected example.

examples.en: Let us look at the notice first.

examples.py: hǎo de , wǒ xiān wèn shí jiān .
examples.en: Okay, I will ask the time first.

commonMistakes.wrong: 开始啊吗吧。这里要给一个建议。
commonMistakes.why: Use the intended suggestion ending rather than stack incompatible endings.

grammar.purpose: Recognize a casual list with unlisted members
grammar.explanation: 书、笔什么的 means things like books and pens; it is not a precise inventory or a question asking what. In a formal list 书、笔等 can serve a similar function. Do not use a vague list for a task needing exact quantities: 两本书、一支笔 is specific. 什么的 does not prove every possible item is included.

examples.py: dài shū , bǐ shén me de jiù xíng .
examples.en: Things like books and pens are enough.

examples.py: wǒ dài bào zhǐ , shū děng .
examples.en: I bring newspapers, books and so on.

examples.zh: 需要两本书，不是随便什么都行。
examples.py: xū yào liǎng běn shū , bù shì suí biàn shén me dōu xíng .
examples.en: Two books are needed, not just anything.

commonMistakes.wrong: 要两本书，带什么的。这是准确数量。
commonMistakes.why: When a quantity is exact, state it rather than imply an open list.

grammar.pattern: 名词 / 代词 + 呢：承接已有话题
grammar.purpose: Recover the omitted question from context
grammar.explanation: 我想读报纸。你呢？ asks what you would like to read, not where you are. 报纸呢？ after looking for objects can mean where the newspaper is. Read the preceding exchange before expanding the omission; 呢 itself does not encode one fixed full question. If uncertain, ask 你是问我想读什么吗？.

examples.py: wǒ xiǎng dú bào zhǐ . nǐ ne ?
examples.en: I want to read a newspaper. What about you?

examples.py: shū zài zhuō shàng . bào zhǐ ne ?
examples.en: The book is on the table. What about the newspaper?

examples.zh: 她先午睡，我呢？我先看书。
examples.py: tā xiān wǔ shuì , wǒ ne ? wǒ xiān kàn shū .
examples.en: She takes a nap first; as for me, I read first.

commonMistakes.wrong: 我想读书。你呢？意思一定是你在哪里。
commonMistakes.right: 我想读书。你呢？这里问你想读什么。
commonMistakes.why: The preceding topic determines the omitted question.

lines.zh: 我姓李，叫李安。我们昨天晚会见过吧？
lines.py: wǒ xìng lǐ , jiào lǐ ān . wǒ men zuó tiān wǎn huì jiàn guò ba ?
lines.en: I'm Li An, surname Li. Didn't we meet at the evening party yesterday?
lines.speaker: b

lines.py: duì ! nǐ zuò zài lǎo wáng páng biān .

lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我还帮他拿了报纸，他今天又带来了。
lines.py: wǒ hái bāng tā ná le bào zhǐ , tā jīn tiān yòu dài lái le .

lines.zh: 他在里面午睡，晚点儿再问吧。

reading.title: A group chat glossary
reading.blurb: An original scene written for this course.
reading.purpose: Follow the situation, the problem and what happens next.

lines.zh: 昨天在晚会上，我认识了李安。他姓李，坐在大家都叫老王的那位朋友旁边，帮老王拿着一份晚报。
lines.py: zuó tiān zài wǎn huì shàng , wǒ rèn shi le lǐ ān . tā xìng lǐ , zuò zài dà jiā dōu jiào lǎo wáng de nà wèi péng you páng biān , bāng lǎo wáng ná zhe yī fèn wǎn bào .
lines.en: I met Li An at yesterday's evening party. His surname was Li. He sat beside the friend everyone calls Lao Wang and helped him carry an evening newspaper.

lines.zh: 今天到读书小组，我又见到了李安。他看见我就笑了，说原来是你啊，昨天说话的人太多，今天可以慢慢聊。
lines.py: jīn tiān dào dú shū xiǎo zǔ , wǒ yòu jiàn dào le lǐ ān . tā kàn jiàn wǒ jiù xiào le , shuō yuán lái shì nǐ a , zuó tiān shuō huà de rén tài duō , jīn tiān kě yǐ màn màn liáo .
lines.en: I saw Li An again at the reading group today. He smiled: oh, it's you! There had been too many people talking yesterday; today we could chat properly.

lines.zh: 老王正在里面午睡，我就先和李安看报纸。第二页写着春节的活动，李安说自己过年要回家，活动结束后就出发。
lines.py: lǎo wáng zhèng zài lǐ miàn wǔ shuì , wǒ jiù xiān hé lǐ ān kàn bào zhǐ . dì èr yè xiě zhe chūn jié de huó dòng , lǐ ān shuō zì jǐ guò nián yào huí jiā , huó dòng jié shù hòu jiù chū fā .
lines.en: Lao Wang was napping inside, so Li An and I read the newspaper first. The second page described a Spring Festival event. Li An would go home for the New Year, leaving after that event.

lines.zh: 我今年想留在这里，和朋友一起过年。我们看见活动要带一道菜，就开始说自己会做什么；李安说他只会煮面。
lines.py: wǒ jīn nián xiǎng liú zài zhè lǐ , hé péng you yì qǐ guò nián . wǒ men kàn jiàn huó dòng yào dài yī dào cài , jiù kāi shǐ shuō zì jǐ huì zuò shén me ; lǐ ān shuō tā zhǐ huì zhǔ miàn .
lines.en: I wanted to stay here and celebrate with friends this year. The event asked everyone to bring a dish, so we talked about what we could cook. Li An said he only knew how to cook noodles.

lines.zh: 老王醒了，走过来问我们读到哪里了。我指给他看那条活动消息，他说晚上大家可以一起来，不用现在就想好带什么。
lines.py: lǎo wáng xǐng le , zǒu guò lái wèn wǒ men dú dào nǎ lǐ le . wǒ zhǐ gěi tā kàn nà tiáo huó dòng xiāo xī , tā shuō wǎn shang dà jiā kě yǐ yì qǐ lái , bù yòng xiàn zài jiù xiǎng hǎo dài shén me .
lines.en: When Lao Wang woke he asked how far we'd read. I showed him the event notice. We could all come that evening, he said; we didn't need to decide on a dish yet.

lines.zh: 回家以后，我给李安发了书店的地址。晚上睡前，他说晚安，还问我下次能不能带一本喜欢的书来。
lines.py: huí jiā yǐ hòu , wǒ gěi lǐ ān fā le shū diàn de dì zhǐ . wǎn shang shuì qián , tā shuō wǎn ān , hái wèn wǒ xià cì néng bù néng dài yī běn xǐ huān de shū lái .
lines.en: Back home I sent Li An the bookshop address. Before bed he said goodnight and asked me to bring a favourite book next time.

lines.en: Oh, it's you! I couldn't see clearly just now.

lines.zh: 今天真热啊。
lines.py: jīn tiān zhēn rè a .
lines.en: It's really hot today.

lines.zh: 有空的话，来坐一会儿。
lines.py: yǒu kōng de huà , lái zuò yī huì er .
lines.en: If you're free, come and sit for a while.

lines.zh: 时间合适的话，我们一起去。
lines.py: shí jiān hé shì de huà , wǒ men yì qǐ qù .
lines.en: If the time works, let's go together.

lines.zh: 我带了书、笔等东西。
lines.py: wǒ dài le shū , bǐ děng dōng xi .
lines.en: I brought books, pens and similar things.

lines.zh: 店里有茶、咖啡等饮料。
lines.py: diàn lǐ yǒu chá , kā fēi děng yǐn liào .
lines.en: The shop has tea, coffee and other drinks.

lines.zh: 这位科学家每天在这里工作。
lines.py: zhè wèi kē xué jiā měi tiān zài zhè lǐ gōng zuò .
lines.en: This scientist works here every day.

lines.zh: 她想成为一位作家。
lines.py: tā xiǎng chéng wéi yī wèi zuò jiā .
lines.en: She wants to become a writer.

lines.zh: 老王今天又是第一个到的。
lines.py: lǎo wáng jīn tiān yòu shì dì yī gè dào de .
lines.en: Lao Wang was first to arrive again today.

lines.zh: 我们都叫这位同事老李。
lines.py: wǒ men dōu jiào zhè wèi tóng shì lǎo lǐ .
lines.en: We all call this colleague Lao Li.

lines.zh: 小李帮我把书拿进来。
lines.py: xiǎo lǐ bāng wǒ bǎ shū ná jìn lái .
lines.en: Xiao Li helped me bring the books in.

lines.zh: 我叫了小王一声，她就回头了。
lines.py: wǒ jiào le xiǎo wáng yī shēng , tā jiù huí tóu le .
lines.en: I called out to Xiao Wang and she turned around.

lines.zh: 我姓王，名字叫王宁。
lines.py: wǒ xìng wáng , míng zi jiào wáng níng .
lines.en: My surname is Wang; my name is Wang Ning.

lines.zh: 你和她都姓李吗？
lines.py: nǐ hé tā dōu xìng lǐ ma ?
lines.en: Do you and she both have the surname Li?

lines.zh: 请在表上写下姓名。
lines.py: qǐng zài biǎo shàng xiě xià xìng míng .
lines.en: Please write your full name on the form.

lines.zh: 我记下了新同学的姓名。
lines.py: wǒ jì xià le xīn tóng xué de xìng míng .
lines.en: I wrote down the new classmate's full name.

lines.zh: 这家书店叫作夜书店。
lines.py: zhè jiā shū diàn jiào zuò yè shū diàn .
lines.en: This bookshop is called Night Bookshop.

lines.zh: 这个小组叫作星期三读书会。
lines.py: zhè gè xiǎo zǔ jiào zuò xīng qī sān dú shū huì .
lines.en: This group is called the Wednesday Reading Club.

lines.zh: 下雨以后，人们都跑进屋里。
lines.py: xià yǔ yǐ hòu , rén men dōu pǎo jìn wū lǐ .
lines.en: People ran indoors after it started raining.

lines.zh: 过节时，人们喜欢一起吃饭。
lines.py: guò jié shí , rén men xǐ huān yì qǐ chī fàn .
lines.en: People like sharing a meal during holidays.

lines.zh: 这座城市的人口比以前多了。
lines.py: zhè zuò chéng shì de rén kǒu bǐ yǐ qián duō le .
lines.en: This city has a larger population than before.

lines.zh: 报纸上写着各个城市的人口。
lines.py: bào zhǐ shàng xiě zhe gè gè chéng shì de rén kǒu .
lines.en: The newspaper lists the populations of different cities.

lines.zh: 全国许多地方都下雨了。
lines.py: quán guó xǔ duō dì fāng dōu xià yǔ le .
lines.en: It rained in many places across the country.

lines.zh: 这本杂志在全国都能买到。
lines.py: zhè běn zá zhì zài quán guó dōu néng mǎi dào .
lines.en: You can buy this magazine throughout the country.

lines.zh: 这家店全年都开门。
lines.py: zhè jiā diàn quán nián dōu kāi mén .
lines.en: This shop opens throughout the year.

lines.zh: 他把全年的照片放进一本书里。
lines.py: tā bǎ quán nián de zhào piān fàng jìn yī běn shū lǐ .
lines.en: He put the year's photos into a book.

lines.zh: 春节我想回家。
lines.py: chūn jié wǒ xiǎng huí jiā .
lines.en: I'd like to go home for Spring Festival.

lines.zh: 我们春节以后再见吧。
lines.py: wǒ men chūn jié yǐ hòu zài jiàn ba .
lines.en: Let's meet after Spring Festival.

lines.zh: 今年在哪里过年？
lines.py: jīn nián zài nǎ lǐ guò nián ?
lines.en: Where are you celebrating the New Year this year?

lines.zh: 过年时，家里来了很多朋友。
lines.py: guò nián shí , jiā lǐ lái le hěn duō péng you .
lines.en: Lots of friends visited us at New Year.

lines.zh: 节日那天，街上很热闹。
lines.py: jié rì nà tiān , jiē shàng hěn rè nào .
lines.en: The street was lively on the holiday.

lines.zh: 她给节日活动做了一个安排。
lines.py: tā gěi jié rì huó dòng zuò le yī gè ān pái .
lines.en: She made a plan for the holiday event.

lines.zh: 晚会晚上七点开始。
lines.py: wǎn huì wǎn shang qī diǎn kāi shǐ .
lines.en: The evening party starts at seven.

lines.zh: 我们一起去参加了学校的晚会。
lines.py: wǒ men yì qǐ qù cān jiā le xué xiào de wǎn huì .
lines.en: We went to the school's evening party together.

lines.zh: 我想午睡一会儿，三点再出门。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng wǔ shuì yī huì er , sān diǎn zài chū mén .
lines.en: I'd like a nap and will go out at three.

lines.zh: 她午睡醒了，给我回了消息。
lines.py: tā wǔ shuì xǐng le , gěi wǒ huí le xiāo xī .
lines.en: She replied after waking from her afternoon nap.

lines.zh: 她笑着说晚安，然后关了灯。
lines.py: tā xiào zhe shuō wǎn ān , rán hòu guān le dēng .
lines.en: She smiled, said goodnight and turned off the light.

lines.zh: 睡前我给朋友发了一句晚安。
lines.py: shuì qián wǒ gěi péng you fā le yī jù wǎn ān .
lines.en: I sent my friend a goodnight message before bed.

lines.zh: 父亲吃完饭就看晚报。
lines.py: fù qīn chī wán fàn jiù kàn wǎn bào .
lines.en: My father reads the evening newspaper after dinner.

lines.zh: 这份晚报的第二页有一张大照片。
lines.py: zhè fèn wǎn bào de dì èr yè yǒu yī zhāng dà zhào piān .
lines.en: There's a large photo on this evening newspaper's second page.

lines.zh: 我在今天的日报里看见了这条消息。
lines.py: wǒ zài jīn tiān de rì bào lǐ kàn jiàn le zhè tiáo xiāo xī .
lines.en: I saw this news in today's daily newspaper.

lines.zh: 这份日报每天早上送到。
lines.py: zhè fèn rì bào měi tiān zǎo shàng sòng dào .
lines.en: This daily newspaper is delivered each morning.

lines.zh: 我把报纸放在桌上。
lines.py: wǒ bǎ bào zhǐ fàng zài zhuō shàng .
lines.en: I put the newspaper on the table.

lines.zh: 看完报纸，我们聊了一会儿。
lines.py: kàn wán bào zhǐ , wǒ men liáo le yī huì er .
lines.en: We chatted after reading the newspaper.
